chunks: (Solomon) said: 'We shall see if you speak the truth or you are a liar.

key_terms.سَنَنظُرُ: We shall see / We will observe

ai.seo_question: What did Solomon say to the Queen of Sheba regarding her sincerity?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Solomon (Sulayman) responds to Queen Bilqis’s diplomatic overtures with a test of sincerity, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on distinguishing between genuine submission to God and political pragmatism. This moment highlights the transition from worldly diplomacy to spiritual truth, where actions serve as the ultimate proof of faith.
